UPDATE ohlc_candles
                SET gap = 1
                WHERE time IN (
                    SELECT c_stable.time
                    FROM ohlc_candles c_stable
                    WHERE c_stable.time >= ?1
                    AND c_stable.stable = 1
                    AND c_stable.gap = 0
                    AND (
                        SELECT stable
                        FROM ohlc_candles
                        WHERE time < c_stable.time
                        ORDER BY time DESC
                        LIMIT 1
                    ) = 0
                )
